name: Den of Flame
summary: Black dragonkin hold the Den of Flame in western Dustwallow Marsh, west of the Stonemaul Ruins. The Stonemaul ogres raised it as their mound, but Onyxia’s brood has driven them out.

sections.title: A Conquered Mound
sections.body: Black dragonspawn patrol the burning edge of the Den of Flame and guard its cavern entrance. The Stonemaul ogres built the rough stone stronghold as their main mound and sanctuary. Then the black dragonflight laid waste to the clan’s settlement. The brood scattered the ogres and seized the mound, where dragonspawn now keep watch beneath the shadow of Onyxia’s nearby lair.

faq.q: What was the Den of Flame originally built for?
faq.answer: The Stonemaul ogres built the Den of Flame as their clan’s main mound. Its stonework and layout follow ogre clan architecture.

faq.q: Why are black dragonkin infesting this mound?
aliases: who lives in den of flame
faq.answer: Onyxia established her lair nearby in the marsh. Her dragonkin drove the Stonemaul ogres from their settlement and claimed the cavern as a forward outpost for the brood.

faq.q: Can the Stonemaul ogres reclaim the cave?
faq.answer: Not for now. The surviving Stonemaul ogres have settled at Brackenwall Village alongside the Horde. Black dragonspawn hold their old mound in force.

angles.text: The Stonemaul ogres are sworn allies of the Horde. Clearing dragonkin from the Den of Flame helps avenge their fallen settlement.
